Adjusting Shim Selection Chart
INTAKE

Intake valve clearance (cold):
0.15 — 0.25 mm (0.006 — 0.010 in.)
Example:
A 2.800 mm shim is installed and the
valve clearance measures 0.450 mm.
Replace the 2.800 mm shim with
shim No. 24 (3.050 mm).
